hypotheses.claim: H-005: Combining linear scale-free radial pull (d_cur-alpha*d_dep)/scale with elongation ratio rho=d_cur/(d0i+d0j), outside-in/radial-load depot-start, and a stronger or capacity-adaptive early-return threshold (sigma<tau, tau increasing with mean_dem/rest_cap) will outperform both Round 2 incumbent (-0.10961) and all frozen rules across scales.
